headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Special Town Council on Friday, December 4
blurb: This special meeting is a single-item public hearing: Town Council sits as an appellate body to review a challenge to HARC's September 16, 2026 approval of a new construction project at 208 S Fir Street. The appellant, an adjacent property owner at 150 W Pacific Avenue, filed the appeal on September 30, 2026.
